evidence_scope: method-free train-world finite-sample recoverability gate; no validation, holdout, or method arm may be run

world_change_under_test.all_other_world_distribution_fields: inherited byte-for-field from the frozen v0.2 manifest

outer_cv_selection_rule.primary: maximise the minimum mean search top-1 gain across the remaining world folds
outer_cv_selection_rule.secondary: maximise mean search top-1 gain across all remaining worlds

formal_ranking_contract.tie_break: offline evaluator reconstructs robot-visible first encounter order from observed_location over the complete frozen rollout; never-observed candidates append in frozen catalogue order
formal_ranking_contract.causal_scope: the complete-rollout encounter order is the formal legacy evaluator contract, not a claim that a deployed online method sees future observations
formal_ranking_contract.search_baseline: current observed location or last observed location pinned first; remaining candidates ranked by cumulative observed counts in encounter order

promotion_requirements.put_back_visible_history_reference: same executable window+shrinkage estimator, compared with sticky visible-owner history and rolling pooled visible-owner history

effective_sample_size_reporting.observed_admissions: number of visible observations passing the owner-probability threshold
effective_sample_size_reporting.active_context_samples: mean count remaining in the matching context cell at unobserved prediction steps
effective_sample_size_reporting.active_effective_mass: active context count plus the configured pooled shrinkage pseudocount when pooled history is nonempty

downstream_prereservation_not_authorized.condition: may be generated only after a formal custodian attests disjointness from all 24 sealed holdout raw world seeds
downstream_prereservation_not_authorized.gate_b_condition: may run only after Gate A passes on these newly generated validation worlds
downstream_prereservation_not_authorized.method_comparison_condition: may resume only after both Gate A and Gate B pass

retrospective_disclosure: The duration, grid, folds, and result scale had been inspected before this design file was created. The outer-CV result is valid train-only development evidence but is not preregistered or confirmatory evidence.
